{{MangaPrevNext/Adventures |prevcode=PS173 |prevtitle=The Last Battle VII |nextcode=PS175 |nexttitle=The Last Battle IX |series=Gold, Silver & Crystal |colorscheme=Johto}} {{ChapInfobox |title_en=The Last Battle VIII |title_ja=最終決戦VIII |title_ro=The Last Battle VIII |image=PS174.png |scheme=Gold, Silver & Crystal |pub1=Shogakukan full volume |pub1-data=Chapter 174 in {{vol|Pokémon Adventures|14}} |pub2=VIZ Media full volume |pub2-data=Adventure 174 in {{vol|Pokémon Adventures|14}} |location=[[Ilex Forest]] }} '''The Last Battle VIII''' (Japanese: '''最終決戦VIII''' ''The Last Battle VIII'') is the 174th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 84th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Gold, Silver & Crystal}}. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} Recalling her nightmarish past, {{adv|Green}} falls to her knees. [[Will]] and [[Karen]], her former colleagues, continue to taunt and mock her - they reveal that {{adv|Silver}}, who Green thought had sent to a safe place, is being held hostage by them. Will has his {{p|Xatu}} split a bush to reveal Silver and his {{TP|Silver|Sneasel}} being pinned to a tree. They crash to the ground right in front of her. Silver reveals to Green that his Sneasel used {{m|Thief}} to steal her {{p|Abra}}'s [[Flower Mail]] just before it {{m|teleport}}ed him [[PS162|earlier]]. The Flower Mail contained a map of the forest, and thus he followed. Green, now flooding her face with tears, apologizes for leaving Silver alone and not knowing that he was taking orders from {{adv|Lance}}. Silver, after one last confession, slips into unconsciousness, causing Green to cry even louder as she recalls her memories with him. Eventually, Green turns towards Will and Karen with a glare, and stuns them when she dodges an attack from {{DL|Tower duo (Adventures)|Ho-Oh}} without even flinching. Green proudly declares herself free of {{wp|ornithophobia}}, stating that she had to work hard on overcoming her fear in order to win a battle against her past. She holds up the three {{i|Poké Ball}}s with which she conquered her phobia with, and releases the Pokémon inside: the {{adv|legendary birds}} of [[Kanto]]. She climbs onto {{p|Moltres}} and they fly towards the [[Ilex Forest shrine]]. Knowing they could not let her near it, Will and Karen get on {{DL|Tower duo (Adventures)|Lugia}} and Ho-Oh respectively to chase. Will soon notices that Silver is clinging onto Lugia's tail and challenging him to a battle. ==Major events== * {{adv|Green}} overcomes her fear of birds. * Green is revealed to have captured {{adv|Legendary birds|Articuno, Zapdos, and Moltres}}. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Green}} * {{adv|Silver}} * [[Karen]] * [[Will]] * [[Masked Man]] (flashback) * [[Sham]] (flashback) * [[Carl]] (flashback) ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Jigglypuff}} ([[Jiggly]]; {{adv|Green}}'s; flashback) * {{p|Ditto}} ([[Ditty]]; {{adv|Green}}'s; flashback) * {{p|Abra}} ({{adv|Green}}'s; flashback) * {{p|Articuno}} ({{DL|Legendary birds (Adventures)|Articuno|Green's}}) * {{p|Zapdos}} ({{DL|Legendary birds (Adventures)|Zapdos|Green's}}) * {{p|Moltres}} ({{DL|Legendary birds (Adventures)|Moltres|Green's}}) * {{p|Sneasel}} ({{OP|Silver|Sneasel}}) * {{p|Xatu}} ([[Will]]'s) * {{p|Lugia}} ({{DL|Tower duo (Adventures)|Lugia|Masked Man's}}) * {{p|Ho-Oh}} ({{DL|Tower duo (Adventures)|Ho-Oh|Masked Man's}}) * {{p|Pidgeotto}} (flashback) * {{p|Fearow}} (flashback) ==Trivia== ===Errors=== * In the [[Chuang Yi]] version, [[Will]] refers to his {{p|Xatu}} as a {{p|Natu}}. ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color={{colorschemelight|Johto}}|bordercolor={{colorschemedark|Johto}} |zh_cmn={{tt|最終決戰 VIII|The Last Battle VIII}} (Taiwan)
